payload.title: Closed one-to-one rule-id to concept-leaf map
payload.description:
A closed, reviewed, versioned map from detector rule id to exactly one canonical concept leaf, with validation that it can never widen to a category.

Replaces `EQUIVALENCE_GROUPS` and `PARENT_TO_CHILDREN` in `tests/eval/identity.ts`. Measured dependence on the current table: of 357 mention cases, 30 match a rule id exactly, **213 match only through the alias table**, and 114 match nothing. Expect measured mention recall to fall hard, correctly, on the first canonical run.

The map may not turn `ssn` into an exact match for every national identifier; parent/child are taxonomy relations reported separately, not equivalences. Validation test must assert one-to-one at the leaf and fail on any group-shaped entry.
